text:
A small shop stood on a quiet street. The shopkeeper, Mr. Ali, was an old man. He was always kind to everyone.

One cold winter day, a poor boy came to the shop. His shoes were old, and he looked hungry. He stood outside and looked at the bread through the window.

Mr. Ali saw him. He went outside and smiled. “Are you hungry?” he asked.

The boy was shy. “I have no money,” he said.

“That’s okay,” said Mr. Ali. He gave the boy bread and a warm cup of milk. “Come back tomorrow, too.”

The boy came every day for a week. Then he stopped coming.

Many years later, Mr. Ali was old and sick. He could not work, and the shop was closed. One day, a young man came to his door. He was a doctor.

“Do you remember me?” he asked. “You gave me bread when I was a boy. Now let me help you.”

Mr. Ali smiled with tears in his eyes.

Moral: Kindness always comes back.

quiz.q: Mr. Ali gave the hungry boy bread and milk.
The boy paid Mr. Ali with money.
Who was the young man who came to Mr. Ali's door years later?
o: The poor boy, now a doctor

quiz.q: What season was it when the boy came to the shop?
